question: Where should mantra placement be done and what is attained?
premises: Mantras are placed in supreme mandala.
All-lord place is attained when worshipped.
inference: The verse links equinox mantra placement in the supreme mandala with attainment of the all-lord place.
uncertainties: kāryo@smin may be a sandhi form.
plain_english: At equinox, place the mantras in the supreme mandala; when this is worshipped, one attains the place of the all-lord.
